cues: A tall plant could be T T or T t.
To find out, cross it with the homozygous recessive, a dwarf.
If the plant was T T, every offspring is tall.
If it was T t, you get one tall to one dwarf.

text: A tall plant could be T T or T t. They look identical. To find out, cross it with the homozygous recessive, a dwarf. That is a test cross. If the plant was T T, every offspring is tall. If it was T t, you get one tall to one dwarf. The offspring ratio is a direct copy of the unknown parent's gametes.
